query:
SELECT l.id, l.title, l.description, c.title as course_title, lang.name as language_name
FROM lessons l
JOIN courses c ON l.courseId = c.id
JOIN languages lang ON c.language_id = lang.id
WHERE lang.code = 'en'
LIMIT 10
